purpose: Connect user-facing property-title routes to the current official form/rule layer without claiming that a form result establishes the legal merits of an individual case.

routes.form: LR Application for Certified Copy of Folio

routes.official_service: Certified copy folio with title plan
routes.form: LR Application for Certified Copy of Folio with Copy of Title Plan Attached

routes.official_service: Official search for entries since first registration or specified period
Inspection/copy of instrument subject to eligibility

routes.rule: Order 96, Rules of the Superior Courts

critical_limits: Rule 160 and Form 89/90 are search mechanisms, not automatic legal conclusions.
A folio/title plan is evidence within the statutory registration system; physical boundary disputes may require additional evidence and legal analysis.
Instrument access is restricted in specified circumstances.
Court procedure must not be presented as evidence that the applicant will succeed.
Fees and operational details must be rechecked immediately before public publication.
verification_chain: USER QUESTION -> ROUTE CLASSIFICATION -> OFFICIAL SERVICE -> CURRENT RULE/FORM -> EVIDENCE RECEIVED -> LEGAL PROPOSITION -> ANSWER
guardrails: No outcome prediction for court proceedings.
Current procedure separated from substantive legal effect.
